ofn:Title: Resilient Pastures for a Changing Climate 2021 - 2025 project participant
ofn:Description:
As part of this project, established goal to have all-year round ground cover on our farm properties. 
Soil tests were completed and are available upon request.

"The Resilient Pastures for A Changing Climate Project is running between 2021-2025 and aims to improve 4,000ha of farming and grazing practices. It aims to demonstrate adaptive natural resource and farm management practices which have the ability to build resilience in the agricultural landscapes within the Western NSW Murray region and beyond."
